action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix authentication state persistence in frontend AuthContext. The login process works correctly and tokens are stored, but the authentication state is not being recognized by Dashboard and SecurityMonitor components. Issues: (1) Dashboard shows welcome screen instead of authenticated content despite successful login, (2) Security monitor shows login prompt instead of security tabs when navigating after login. Check AuthContext user state management, component authentication checks, and ensure proper state propagation across all protected components.
